offers_products.reason: Supplies uniforms, workwear, floor mats, towels, PPE and restroom supplies; also sells garments and manufactures them.

offers_services.reason: Core business is uniform rental with weekly pickup, laundering, repair and delivery, plus managed facility services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are businesses, municipalities and institutions; employees wear uniforms but employers choose and buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves manufacturers, healthcare, food processors, auto shops, municipalities and utilities with uniform rental programs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Weekly route-based uniform rental and facility supply contracts generate ongoing repeat revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Uniform rental and sanitation supplies are routine, contract-based needs; headcount cuts affect volume only modestly.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent weekly rental billings for garments, mats and supplies.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from garment inventory, industrial laundry plants and delivery fleet rather than staff expertise.

large_customers.reason: Serves businesses of all types and sizes, including many small shops, local governments and mid-sized firms.

asset_heavy.reason: Requires industrial laundry plants, delivery vehicle fleets and large rental garment inventory.
